I have a ^xFFFF77Leveling Run^7 from ^xFFFF77Level 1^7 all the way to ^xFFFF77Act 1^7^xFFFF770^7 which will hold your hand and show you what to do on ^xE05030YouTube^7. If you are new to the game or would like to level along with me, you can find it here.

^xD020903.28 Changes^7
There are ^xFFFF774^7 major nerfs that have happened in ^xFFFF773.28^7. Both the ^x8888FF% increased Energy Shield^7 from ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 and the ^xFFFF77Hybrid^7 ^x7070FFES^7/^x70FF70Evasion^7 ^xFFFF77Mastery^7 giving ^x8888FF% increased Evasion^7 have been nerfed.
This comes out to ~^xFFFF775% less EHP^7 in ^xFFFF77Tier 16^7, ~^xFFFF7710% less EHP^7 at ~^xFFFF7715 Div^7 - ^xAF6025Mageblood^7 and ~^xFFFF7720% less EHP^7 post ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7. For the vast majority of your ^xFFFF77Leaguestart^7 this should basically make no noticeable difference. Even in the ^xE05030Endgame^7, given ^xFFFF77T17s^7 are gone, this shouldn't matter outside of ^x7070FFValdo Maps^7. Even then, anything but ^x70FF702-4 Ghosted^7 ^xAF6025Feared^7 should be quite comfortable.
On top of that, the ^xFFFF77Tigers^7 from the ^xFFFF77Farrul Ascendancy^7 have received a ^xFFFF7750% less Health^7 nerf. In ^xFFFF77Tier 16 Maps^7 this shouldn't matter as they will likely never get low. In some ^xFFFF77Tier 16.5^7 and ^xFFFF77Uber^7 content they might now die more often but their ^xFFFF770.2 Trigger CD^7 has not been touched so you will just instantly resummon them if they happen to die anyways. This change can just be ignored but it is worth mentioning.
The last nerf is more of a global nerf to all builds with the loss of ^xFFFF77Grafts^7. This build cared about ^xFFFF77Grafts^7 a bit more than the average build so it is a slightly bigger nerf here. This comes out to ~^xFFFF775% less DPS^7 in ^xFFFF77Tier 16^7, ~^xFFFF7710% less DPS^7 at ~^xFFFF7715 Div^7 - ^xAF6025Mageblood^7 and ~^xFFFF7717% less DPS^7 post ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7. Keep in mind the average loss for pretty much all builds also comes out to ~^xFFFF775-10% DPS^7 anyways so outside of the super super ^xE05030Endgame^7 setup, it's the same.
This nerf in the ^xE05030Endgame^7 is not something that will be too noticeable due to the build's high ^xFFFF77DPS^7 and the ^xFFFF77DPS^7 numbers in ^xFFFF77PoB^7 have been updated to reflect that. This will also be offset slightly by the new ^xD02090Corruption Coins^7 that ^xFFFF77Mirage^7 will add allowing you to add a ^xFFFF77Level 1 Support Gem^7 to your ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7.
In our case you would ideally want to go for a ^xFFFF77Level 1^7 ^x70FF70Faster Projectiles^7 if possible but any other ^xFFFF77Support^7 that gives you some form of ^xFFFF77DPS^7 increase is fine too. Ideally this should be stronger than getting ^xFFFF7721/20^7 ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 and try to stay away from any ^xFFFF77Support^7 ^xD02090Corruption^7 that is the same as the ^xFFFF77Supports^7 the build already uses, you would not want to replace those.
^x70FF70 ^x70FF70Act 1^7
Look for ^x70FF70Movement Speed^7 boots in ^xFFFF77Town^7 & use two ^xFFFF77Sceptres^7. Vendor ^xFFFF77Armor Scraps^7 or ^xFFFF77Whetstones^7 for more ^xFFFF77Wisdoms^7. Look for ^x7070FFBBB^7 anything in ^xFFFF77Town^7 before going to the ^xFFFF77Coast^7. If there is no ^x7070FFBBB^7, then look for a ^x7070FFBB^7 ^xFFFF772-Link^7 at a minimum. A ^xFFFF77Wand^7 can be used if needed.
If you happen to find a^xB97123 +1 Fire^7/^x7070FF+1 Spell^7 ^xFFFF77Wand^7/^xFFFF77Sceptre^7 then you should use that for most of ^xFFFF77Act 1^7. Grab a second ^xFFFF77Wand^7 if this does happen on a ^xFFFF77Wand^7 base. You can ^xFFFF77Weapon Swap^7 to ^xFFFF772 Sceptres^7 for ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 until you find a good replacement if you want, or just swap over to using ^xFFFF772 Sceptres^7 full-time at ^xFFFF77Level 10^7 with ^xE05030Leap Slam^7.
^xD02090>>>>^7Please make sure you have 2 ^x8888FFMana^7 ^xFFFF77Flasks^7 before ^xFFFF77Brutus^7 and ^xFFFF77Merveil^7 or you will have a bad time with mana^xD02090<<<< ^7 ^xFFFF77Act 1 Regex^7 (shows ^xFFFF774-Links^7, ^x7070FFBBB^7, ^x7070FFBB^7, ^x70FF70MS Boots^7, ^xFFFF77Sceptres^7): "-\w-.-|b-b-b|b-b|Runn|rint|ll g|s:.+sc" Copy this and then paste it into the search box on ^xFFFF77Gear Vendors^7 to highlight these things if they have them.
^xFFFF77Level 1^7^7 Take^x7070FF Rolling Magma^7 from the quest and link it to ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7. Use ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 for everything up until ^xFFFF77Level 28^7.
Try to get ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 to ^xFFFF77Level 2^7 in ^xFFFF77The Coast^7. This will make the next zone a bit easier with ^xFFFF77Rhoas^7.
^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 will bounce ^xFFFF774^7 times from the point at which your ^xFFFF77Cursor^7 was at. The bounces will always jump the same distance and can multi-hit enemies with bigger hitboxes, namely ^xAF6025Bosses^7. Try to aim slightly in front of any ^xAF6025Boss^7 you are fighting so it can potentially get hit by multiple bounces.
For clearing you simply will just put down a ^x7070FFFlame Wall^7 once you obtain it at ^xFFFF77Level 4^7, and aim for your ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 to go through it to gain ^xB97123Added Fire Damage^7. This isn't very precise and you don't need to overthink it. Just put the ^x7070FFFlame Wall^7 on top of yourself or on top of a ^xAF6025Boss^7.
^xFFFF77Level 4^7 After ^xFFFF77Mud Flats^7 is over and you are in ^xFFFF77The Submerged Passage^7, teleport back to ^xFFFF77The Coast^7 waypoint and go get the ^x70FF70Medicine Chest^7 from the ^xFFFF77Tidal Island^7.
Take ^x7070FFFlame Wall^7 & ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 from ^xFFFF77Tarkleigh^7. Take ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 from ^xFFFF77Nessa^7. Buy ^xE05030Holy Flame Totem^7 from ^xFFFF77Nessa^7.
Link^x7070FF Rolling Magma^7 - ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7 - ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 Leave ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 at ^xFFFF77Level 1^7, you can dismiss the^xFFFF77 Level-Up^7 notification by ^xFFFF77Right-Clicking^7 on the ^xFFFF77+^7.
If you do not have space, link ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 to ^x7070FFFrostblink^7.
Use ^xE05030Holy Flame Totem^7 on ^xAF6025Bosses^7. You can use it on ^xFFFF77Rares^7 too if needed. Use ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 on cooldown as your ^x70FF70Movement Skill^7.
At ^xFFFF77Level 5^7 you can use ^xFFFF77Darkwood Sceptre^7 bases, try to look for one from ^xFFFF77Tarkleigh^7 or the floor.
You will get a guaranteed ^x8888FFEssence^7 from the ^xAF6025Dweller^7. Use it on your ^xFFFF77Sceptre^7 in hopes for ^x8888FF% Spell Damage^7, ^xB97123% Fire Damage^7^7 or any ^x8888FFAdded Spell Damage^7. If you get a second ^x8888FFEssence^7 from a random monster as your level, you should use them on your ^xFFFF77Weapons^7 only to try and get an upgrade.
^xFFFF77~Level 8-9^7 Once you get to the ^xFFFF77Prison^7, you should take the ^xFFFF77Waypoint^7 back to ^xFFFF77Town^7.
Take ^x7070FFCombustion^7 from ^xFFFF77Nessa^7 and link it to ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 in place of ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7. Move ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 to ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 if you haven't yet.
Buy ^xE05030Added Fire Damage^7 from ^xFFFF77Nessa^7 and link it to ^xE05030Holy Flame Totem^7. This will simply help kill ^xFFFF77Brutus^7 and ^xFFFF77Merveil^7 faster and is not a high priority if you do not have anything with ^xE05030RR^7.
Buy a second ^xFFFF77Mana Flask^7 and upgrade your other one if you have not done so yet. Having two good ^xFFFF77Mana Flasks^7 will make ^xFFFF77Brutus^7 a lot easier.
^xFFFF77After Killing Brutus^7
Take ^x7070FFClarity^7 from the quest reward offered by ^xFFFF77Tarkleigh^7. Socket this when you can and activate the ^x8888FFAura^7. Leave this at ^xFFFF77Level 1^7.
Buy ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 from ^xFFFF77Nessa^7^7. You should now use ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 alongside ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 for even faster mobility. You can press ^x7070FFFrostblink^7 as you are about to land with ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 to animation cancel it, making you overall faster.
Keep ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 at ^xFFFF77Level 1^7 as it does not gain any extra speed from additional levels and it only increases ^xFFFF77Mana^7 costs. Make sure to always use ^xFFFF772 Sceptres^7 from now on until ^xFFFF77Act 7^7. This will give you a passive ^xFFFF77Dual Wielding^7 bonus which gives you ^x70FF70Attack Speed^7 making ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 faster.
From here, just finish up ^xFFFF77Act 1^7 as there are no more changes.
^xFFFF77Weapon & Gear Stats Act 1-7^7
For ^xFFFF77Act 1^7 it largely does not matter what stats you have on your gear but it is worth briefly discussing what to look for.
First, you should always look for ^xFFFF77Boots^7 with ^x70FF70Movement Speed^7 on them. Check the ^xFFFF77Gear Vendor^7 in each ^xFFFF77Town^7 whenever you have to go back and use the ^xFFFF77Regex^7 to quickly find any. You can always use ^xFFFF77Gold^7 to ^xFFFF77Gamble^7 for ^xFFFF77Boots^7 if needed. If you have ^xFFFF77Boots^7, then use your ^xFFFF77Gold^7 to ^xFFFF77Gamble^7 for ^xFFFF77Sceptres^7 as needed.
On all of your ^xFFFF77Gear^7 you are just looking for ^xE05030Life^7 and ^xD02090Resistances^7. It does not matter what ^xFFFF77Base^7 you use but if possible, try to use ^xFFFF77Armour Bases^7. Try to use a ^xFFFF77Body Armour^7 with no ^xE05030Life^7 rolls on it. This will allow you to pick up the ^x8888FF15% Increased Life Mastery^7 which is significantly stronger.
Lastly, on your ^xFFFF77Weapons^7 you are looking for ^x8888FF% Spell Damage^7, ^x8888FF% Fire Damage^7 & any ^x8888FFAdds x Damage to Spells^7 rolls. You have a preference for ^x8888FFAdded Fire Damage to Spells^7 but all three types are a ^xFFFF77DPS^7 increase.
^x8888FFCast Speed^7 also feels good as well but it is not as high of a priority.
If you find a ^xFFFF77Scpectre^7 with ^x7070FF+1 Spells^7^7 or ^xB97123+1 Fire Spells^7, you should keep that for a very long time. In ^xFFFF77Act 2^7 you will unlock the ability to use the ^xFFFF77Crafting Bench^7 in your ^xFFFF77Hideout^7 after helping ^xFFFF77Helena^7 in the ^xFFFF77Chamber of Sins^7. Use the ^xFFFF77Bench^7 to craft a useful ^xFFFF77Prefix^7 if said ^xFFFF77+1 Sceptre^7 has an ^xFFFF77Open Prefix^7. I would not recommend wasting currency doing this on anything else than a ^xFFFF77+1 Weapon^7.
^x70FF70Act 2^7
^xFFFF77BANDITS^7^7: Help ^xFFFF77Alira^7, ^x8888FF+15% Elemental Resistance^7 is too good for ^xFFFF77Leaguestart^7. Later, we will swap to ^xFFFF77Eramir^7 for ^xFFFF77+1 Passive Point^7 once we are in ^xFFFF77Maps^7.
The swap to ^xFFFF77Eramir^7 will happen once you have swapped to the ^x7070FFMana Stacking^7 setup with ^x7070FFKinetic Blast of Clustering^7. To swap to ^xFFFF77Eramir^7 in ^xFFFF77Maps^7, simply vendor ^xFFFF7720 Orbs of Regret^7 and ^xFFFF771 Onyx Amulet^7 together and you will receive a ^xFFFF77Book^7. ^xFFFF77 Wiki Page^7 - https://www.poewiki.net/wiki/Deal_with_the_Bandits
^xFFFF77Level 16^7 Take ^x7070FFHerald of Thunder^7 as your quest reward from ^xFFFF77Greust^7. Buy ^x70FF70Herald of Ice^7 & ^x7070FFArcane Cloak ^7from ^xFFFF77Yenna^7.
Turn on both ^xFFFF77Heralds^7 for a ^xFFFF77DPS^7 increase. Your ^x7070FFMana^7 should feel fine as long as you have an upgraded ^xFFFF77Mana Flask^7. Put ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7 in your^xFFFF77 Off-Hand^7 to gain ^xFFFF77Experience^7 for ^xFFFF77Act 4^7.
^xFFFF77Level 20^7 Take ^x7070FFFaster Casting^7 from ^xFFFF77Silk^7 after you kill ^xFFFF77The Weaver^7, put this somewhere to gain ^xFFFF77Experience^7. You will use this as your^xFFFF77 4-Link^7 if you get a ^x7070FFBBBB^7 item in ^xFFFF77Act 3^7.
^x70FF70Act 3^7
^xFFFF77Start looking for^7: ^x8888FF^7^x7070FFBBB^7X for ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 - ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7 - ^x7070FFCombustion^7 - ^xFFFF774th Support^7 (more below) ^xE05030R^7^x70FF70GG^7 for ^xE05030Leap Slam^7 - ^x70FF70Faster Attacks^7 - ^x70FF70Momentum^7
Our goal is to get a ^xFFFF774-Link^7 as soon as possible for ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7. Luckily our ^xFFFF774th Support^7 is flexible and ^xE05030Cruelty^7 & ^x7070FFFaster Casting^7 both work. Sadly you cannot buy ^x70FF70Added Cold Damage^7. This means as long as it has ^x7070FFBBB^7 you are ok with any ^xFFFF774th-Link^7.
^xE05030Cruelty^7 can be bought in ^xFFFF77Act 2^7, and you should have a ^x7070FFFaster Casting^7 from ^xFFFF77Silk^7.
Check ^xFFFF77Hargan^7 every time you come back to ^xFFFF77Town^7 as he has a chance to sell ^xFFFF774-Links^7.
At ^xFFFF77Level 28^7 we will be swapping from ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 to ^x7070FFFirestorm^7 as it feels significantly better to use. We will be using this all the way until ^xFFFF77Act 7^7 when we will swap over to ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7 after the ^xFFFF77Second Lab^7.
Pick up all ^xFFFF77Yellow^7 items, you are going to need lots of ^xFFFF77Alterations^7 to buy all of the gems.
^xFFFF77Level 24^7 Take ^x7070FFFlammability^7 from ^xFFFF77Maramoa^7 and buy ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7, ^x7070FFAutomation^7 & ^xE05030Anger^7 from ^xFFFF77Clarissa^7.
Start using ^x7070FFFlammability^7 on ^xAF6025Bosses^7 for extra ^xFFFF77DPS^7.
Remove both ^x7070FFHerald of Thunder^7 & ^x70FF70Herald of Ice^7 and replace them with ^xE05030Anger^7. Put ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 & ^x7070FFAutomation^7 in an ^xFFFF77Off-Hand Weapon^7 to gain ^xFFFF77Experience^7 for later on.
^xFFFF77Level 26^7
You should stop at ^xFFFF77Maramoa^7 and ^xFFFF77Gamble^7 some^x7070FF Intelligence ^xFFFF77Gloves^7. ^xFFFF77Level 26^7 is the breakpoint for you having a ~^xFFFF7750^7/^xFFFF7750^7 chance to find one with a^xFFFF77 4-Link^7 if using all of the ^xFFFF77Gold^7 you have.
If you don't get one that is ok, just keep going. You can try this later if needed or you can save your gold for later.
^xFFFF77Level 28^7 In the ^xFFFF77Ebony Barracks^7 kill ^xFFFF77General Gravicius^7 then go back to ^xFFFF77Town^7.
Take ^x7070FFFirestorm^7 from ^xFFFF77Maramoa^7 and replace ^x7070FFRolling Magma^7 with it. Remove ^x7070FFElemental Proliferation^7 and replace it with ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 from ^x7070FFFrostblink^7. You should start leveling it now.
Use either ^xE05030Cruelty^7 or ^x7070FFFaster Casting^7 as your ^xFFFF774th Support^7 based on what ^xFFFF774-Link^7 you found.
You can now get rid of ^xE05030Holy Flame Totem^7 & ^x7070FFFlame Wall^7 along with the ^xE05030Added Fire Damage^7.
From now on you will just use ^x7070FFFirestorm^7 to clear along with ^x7070FFFlammability^7 on ^xAF6025Bosses^7.
^xFFFF77Level 30^7 Go to the ^xFFFF77Library^7 and do the quest for ^xFFFF77Siosa^7.
Take ^xE05030Arrogance^7 as your quest reward. Buy ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7, ^x70FF70Faster Attacks^7, ^x70FF70Momentum^7 & ^xE05030Ballista Totem^7 from ^xFFFF77Siosa^7.
If you happened to get a ^xFFFF774-Link^7^7 that has a ^x70FF70Green Socket^7 you can also buy ^x70FF70Added Cold Damage^7 here.
You can also use this ^xFFFF77Regex^7: Power Siphon|Faster attacks|Momentum|Ballista totem|Arcane Cloak
Link ^x70FF70Faster Attacks^7 & ^x70FF70Momentum^7 to^xE05030 Leap Slam^7 as soon as you can for a large ^x70FF70Movement Speed^7 increase. Put ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7, ^xE05030Arrogance^7 & ^xE05030Ballista Totem^7 in your ^xFFFF77Off-Hand^7 to gain ^xFFFF77Experience^7 for ^xFFFF77Act 7^7.
If you do not have the correct colors as we are now leveling ^xFFFF776 Gems^7, prioritize ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7, ^xE05030Ballista Totem^7 & ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7. ^x7070FFAutomation^7, ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 & ^xE05030Arrogance^7 can always be leveled later on when you can fit everything.
Buy an extra ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 for ^xFFFF77Lab^7 in ^xFFFF77Act 4^7. You don't need to level this, just keep it in your inventory.
^x70FF70Act 4^7 Start looking for ^x7070FFBB^7^xE05030R^7^x70FF70G^7 to be able to swap to ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7 in ^xFFFF77Act 7^7. I am mentioning this now as it might take a while for you to find this. Start picking up every ^xFFFF77Wand^7 you see as you must use one with ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7. The ideal ^xFFFF77Wands^7 are ones with ^xADAA47Added Lightning Damage^7 & ^x8888FF% Spell Damage^7 at the least.
^xFFFF77Lab^7
Buy a ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 from ^xFFFF77Siosa^7 before doing ^xFFFF77Lab^7. Once you complete it, you are given one use of the ^xFFFF77Font^7. The ^xFFFF77Font^7 will allow you to change a ^xFFFF77Skill Gem^7 into a random ^xFFFF77Transfigured Skill Gem^7 of the same color. Simply use your^x7070FF Kinetic Blast^7 for this and pray for the somewhat low chance for you to be offered ^x7070FFKinetic Blast of Clustering^7.
Starting with the ^xFFFF77Act 10 Lab^7, there is a chance to get an option that says something along the lines of "^x8888FFChange a Skill Gem into its transfigured version.^7" This will instantly allow you to change ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 into ^x7070FFKinetic Blast of Clustering^7 which is the superior version of the skill allowing us to start properly ^x7070FFMana Stacking^7.
Do ^xFFFF77Lab^7 after ^xFFFF77Level 31^7 when your gems upgrade. Do your best do dodge all of ^xFFFF77Izaro's^7 skills, you can swap ^xE05030Anger^7 out for ^x7070FFPurity of Elements^7 if needed. While ^xFFFF77Izaro^7 has some ^xB97123Elemental^7 skills, his ^xFFFF77Heavy Attack^7 & ^xFFFF77Auto-Attacks^7 are significantly deadlier. Stay near him while constantly running behind him.
Pick up ^xFFFF77Conviction of Power^7 as your first^xFFFF77 Ascendancy Node^7.
If you happen to get ^x7070FFKinetic Blast of Clustering^7, you should keep leveling it as before. You will not use this until ^xFFFF77Maps^7 due to us having very little ^x7070FFMana^7 to make it worthwhile over normal ^x7070FFPower Siphon^7.
^xD02090NOTE^7: It's completely ok if you do not get ^x7070FFKinetic Blast of Clustering^7 while leveling. Obtaining it will be our first goal as soon as we get to ^xFFFF77Maps^7 anyways and it is simple to farm if you wish to get your own. Think of it as a lucky outcome if you do end up getting it earlier.
^xFFFF77Level 36^7 After killing both ^xAF6025Kaom^7 and ^xAF6025Daresso^7 and opening the ^xFFFF77Door^7 to ^xFFFF77The Belly of the Beast^7, go back to ^xFFFF77Town^7 and grab ^x7070FFUnleash^7 from ^xFFFF77Dialla^7.
Link ^x7070FFUnleash^7 to ^x7070FFFirestorm^7 - ^x7070FFUnleash^7 - ^x7070FFCombustion^7 - ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7.
If you have a ^xFFFF774-Link^7 that has a ^xE05030Red^7 or ^x70FF70Green^7 ^xFFFF77Support^7, then replace ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 with ^x7070FFUnleash^7. Start looking for a ^x7070FFBBBB^7 if you do not have one yet to add ^x7070FFArcane Surge^7 back in.
^xFFFF77Level 38^7 After killing ^xAF6025Malachai^7 take^x70FF70 Ice Golem^7 from ^xFFFF77Oyun^7 and put it in your ^xFFFF77Off-Hand^7 to gain ^xFFFF77Experience^7 for ^xFFFF77Act 7^7.
Buy ^xE05030Eternal Blessing^7 &^x7070FF Sigil of Power^7 from ^xFFFF77Petarus and Vanja^7 and link it to ^xE05030Anger^7 while removing ^x7070FFClarity^7. If you do not have any ^xFFFF77Alchemy Orbs^7 you can do this whole step later. Priotize ^xE05030Eternal Bleesing^7 to setup ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7 as mentioned below.
Take ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7 & ^x7070FFAutomation^7 from your ^xFFFF77Off-Hand^7 and link them together.
^xD02090Note^7 - Make sure you activate your ^x7070FFAutomation^7 skill. You cannot use ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7 manually and ^x7070FFAutomation^7 needs to be turned on just like an ^x8888FFAura^7 for it to trigger^x7070FF Arcane Cloak^7.
Go back to ^xFFFF77Act 3^7 and buy ^xE05030More Duration^7 from ^xFFFF77Clarissa^7, link it to ^x7070FFSigil of Power^7.
If you do not have the space to run ^x7070FFArcane Cloak^7 & ^x7070FFSigil of Power^7 yet, that is fine; you can always add them in as soon as you can. ^x7070FFSigil of Power^7 is also fine to use by itself with no ^xE05030More Duration^7.

For clearing, you will simply use^x7070FF Kinetic Blast^7 for everything. It will feel a bit scuffed at first until you ^xFFFF77Anoint Split Shot^7 on your ^xFFFF77Amulet^7 which you should do ^xD02090ASAP^7. Once you've done so it should feel butter smooth.
For ^xAF6025Bosses^7, you will simply use ^x7070FFKinetic Fusillade^7. This skill will generate ^xFFFF77Orbs^7 which will launch after a short delay. ^x7070FFKinetic Fusillade^7 has a ^xFFFF7712% More Damage^7 multiplier for each ^xFFFF77Orb^7 fired meaning the final one does ^xFFFF77144% More Damage^7. With ^x70FF70Greater Volley^7 and the ^x70FF70+1 Projectile^7 ^xFFFF77Wand Mastery^7, you will generate ^xFFFF776 Orbs^7 every time meaning after two casts you get to the cap of ^xFFFF7712^7. ^x7070FFFusillade^7 has a ^x70FF70200% Attack Speed^7 multiplier making this very quick.

You can also use ^xFFFF77Kinetic Fusillade^7 on ^xFFFF77Rares^7 if needed but ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 should destroy them especially if there are ^xFFFF77Walls^7 or any other monsters nearby. Some ^xAF6025Bosses^7 might also die quicker with ^x7070FFKinetic Blast^7 due to this.

For ^x7070FFKinetic Fusillade^7, it will end up being a ^xFFFF77Single Target DPS^7 increase due to ^x7070FFFusillade's^7 mechanics. The ^xFFFF77Orbs^7 from ^x7070FFFusillade^7 come with ^x70FF70+3 Chain^7 and will do a small explosion on impact. With this, you can stand on top of a ^xAF6025Boss^7, have the ^x70FF70Tornado^7 spawn on them, and then have ^x7070FFFusillade^7 hit either the ^x70FF70Tornado^7 or the ^xAF6025Boss^7 and then ^x70FF70Chain^7 to the other. Due to this, its time to craft a new ^xFFFF77Rare Helmet^7 that will give you ~^xFFFF77300-400^7 more ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 than even a maxrolled ^xAF6025Mindspiral^7 along with ~^xFFFF773%^7 more ^xFFFF77DPS^7. We will also finally have access to ^xFFFF77Eldritch Implicits^7 so we gain ~^xFFFF779%^7 more ^xFFFF77Physical Damage Reduction^7 which is a very difficult stat to gain.
This ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 should cost ~^xFFFF7710-15 Divine^7 to craft in total. ^xD02090Note^7 - You will need a ^xFFFF77Level 4^7 ^x7070FFEnlighten^7 to make use of the ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 once crafted.
^x7070FFHelmet Crafting Guide^7
Buy an ^xFFFF77Item Level 84^7 or higher ^xFFFF77Lich's Circlet^7 that is over ^xFFFF7720% Quality^7 or higher with a ^xADAA47Fractured^7 ^xFFFF77Tier 1^7 ^x8888FFx% increased Energy Shield^7 mod. You can also go for a higher ^xFFFF77Quality^7 if you wish or, if it is too expensive, you can get something cheaper. You can also get a lower roll on the ^xADAA47Fractured^7 mod if needed. Ideally if you can afford a ^xFFFF7729% Quality^7 base you should get that.
^xFFFF77Helmet Base Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/Z6q9B2eEfQ
1. Use ^x8888FFDeafening Essences of Woe^7 to guarantee ^x8888FF+x to Maximum Energy Shield^7 until you get ^xFFFF77Tier 1^7 ^x7070FFMana^7. This should be a ~^xFFFF771/69^7 chance. At this point in the build, anything but perfection is pointless given how much money has gone into it so only use ^x8888FFDeafening^7 and only go for ^xFFFF77Tier 1^7.
2. You will need ^xFFFF773 Open Suffixes^7, use a ^x3F6DB3Eater of Worlds Ichor^7 on the ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 then use ^xFFFF77Eldritch Orbs of Annulment^7 to remove all ^xFFFF77Suffixes^7.
3. Go to the ^xFFFF77Crafting Bench^7 and craft "^x8888FFCan have up to 3 Crafted Modifiers^7" followed by "^x8888FF+x to Intelligence^7" and "^x8888FF% increased Rarity of Items Dropped by Slain Rare or Unique Enemies^7." The ^xFFFF77Rarity^7 mod is the only other useful ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 we have access to and it will increase your ^xFFFF77Gold^7 gain. You can choose to skip this and to craft a ^xD02090Resistance^7 instead if needed or to not bother with the multimod.
4. Use ^x3F6DB3Grand Eater of Worlds Ichors^7 on the ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 until you get "^x8888FF7% of Physical Damage from Hits taken as Chaos Damage^7." You should not use lower tier ^x3F6DB3Ichors^7 as this mod is the whole reason we crafted this ^xFFFF77Helmet^7. Use ^xB97123Grand Searing Exarch Embers^7 on the ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 until you get either "^x8888FF% increased Despair Curse Effect^7" or "^x8888FFWhile a Unique Enemy is in your Presence, x% increased Despair Curse Effect^7." The ^xAF6025Unique^7 version of the ^x7070FFDespair^7 mod is better as you never use ^x7070FFDespair^7 on anything but ^xAF6025Bosses^7 anyways. The normal one is fine too as the ^xAF6025Unique^7 one is quite rare.
^xFFFF77Enlighten Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/eRGyE9QWIL
You will now need to buy a ^xFFFF77Level 4 ^x7070FFEnlighten^7 which will be linked to ^x70FF70Precision^7, ^x70FF70Grace^7 & ^x70FF70Haste^7. ^x70FF70Second Wind^7 will also need to be removed from ^x7070FFWall of Force^7 to make space for ^x7070FFClarity^7.
^xE05030Endgame^7 - ^x70FF70New Greatwolf Talisman^7
^xFFFF77Greatwolf Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/yYpbM87eCR
It's time to finally get a better second mod on your ^xAF6025Greatwolf Talisman^7. Previously we looked for one with ^x8888FFx% increased Maximum Mana^7 and one of a handful of useful secondacy mods. We will now want to look for a new one with the ^x8888FFx% increased Maximum Mana^7 mod along with ^x8888FFx% increased Attributes^7.
This will be your ^xFFFF77BiS^7 ^xFFFF77Amulet^7 for the rest of your time playing this build and even a mid-rolled one will beat a perfect double ^xFFFF77%^7 and ^x8888FFDamage per Intelligence^7 ^xFFFF77Simplex^7. The only way to beat this would be with a ^xFFFF77Reflected^7 ^xFFFF77Simplex^7 which would cost.. ^x7070FFMirrors^7.
A two-mod ^xAF6025Greatwolf^7 like this will be expensive and the very well rolled ones are going to cost a lot of money. It is up to you which of the two mods you want to prioritize. A higher ^x7070FFAttribute^7 roll will give you more ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 while a higher ^x7070FFMana^7 roll will give you slightly more ^xFFFF77DPS^7. I personally recommend to focus on the ^x7070FFAttribute^7 roll as at this point ^xFFFF77DPS^7 starts to become a bit pointless.
Once you buy one, ^xFFFF77Anoint Tranquility^7 on it again just like before and then use ^xD02090Tainted Catalyst^7 to get either ^xFFFF7720%^7 ^xE05030Life^7 and ^x7070FFMana^7 modifiers or ^xFFFF7720%^7 ^x7070FFAttribute^7 modifiers. Again the choice is up to you, ^x7070FFMana^7 is more ^xFFFF77DPS^7 while ^x7070FFAttribute^7 is higher tankiness.
^xE05030Endgame^7^7 - ^x70FF70Atziri's Reflection^7
^xFFFF77Atziri's Reflection Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/mkZKb3Yeh6
It is now time to upgrade your ^xFFFF77Shield^7 over to ^xAF6025Atziri's Reflection^7. This will come at a slight ^xFFFF77DPS^7 loss which we will just ignore as it will be practically unperceivable. The upside of making this swap is that you will gain quite a lot of ^x70FF70Evasion^7 and a decent chunk of ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 making you tankier.
At this point in the build there shouldn't be anything that you don't have the ^xFFFF77DPS^7 for so, focusing on making sure you never die is our only real priority to make the build as strong as it can be.
^xAF6025Atziri's Reflection^7 will also come with^x8888FF Unaffected by Curses^7 giving you total ^xFFFF77Curse Immunity^7. This makes ^x70FF70Temporal Chains^7 maps not annoying anymore and it takes care of the nasty triple ^x7070FFCurse^7 ^xFFFF77T16.5 Mod^7.
^xE05030Endgame^7 - ^xFFFF77Int Stacking Cluster Jewels^7
^xFFFF77Cluster Jewel Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/nrby74qlS0
The major upgrade for this ^xFFFF77Step^7 will be to upgrade to two^x7070FF Int Stacking^7 ^xFFFF77Cluster Jewels^7. These will drastically spike your ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 giving you a lot more ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 and ^x7070FFMana^7, making for a large ^xFFFF77DPS^7 and ^xFFFF77EHP^7 increase. These ^xFFFF77Cluster Jewels^7 will be ^xFFFF7712 Passive Points^7 on a ^x8888FF10% Spell Damage^7 base. You are going to specifically want^xFFFF77 Item Level 84^7 or higher bases to be able to get ^x8888FF35% increased Effect ^7as a ^xFFFF77Prefix^7.
As for the rest of the mods, you are going to want ^x7070FFIntelligence^7, ^x7070FFMana^7 and ^xFFFF77All Attributes^7. Do not get anything else as it will likely be a waste of money and it will be difficult to resell. ^x7070FFInt Stacking^7 ^xFFFF77Cluster Jewels^7 already sell quite slowly as it is. You can look for a ^xFFFF77Tier 2^7 ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 or ^x7070FFMana^7 roll if needed as that will make these a lot cheaper. A perfect all ^xFFFF77T1 Cluster^7 will cost ~^xFFFF7730-50 Divine Orbs^7 per based on demand.
I ^xD02090DO NOT^7 recommend attempting to craft these.^x7070FF Int Stacking^7 ^xFFFF77Clusters^7 are easily one of the single most miserable items in ^xFFFF77PoE^7 to craft, requiring thousands of ^xFFFF77Alteration Orbs^7 along with a very unfun ^xFFFF77Imprint^7 - ^xFFFF77Regal^7 - ^xFFFF77Exalted Orb^7 process to finish them. You will likely burn out and quit the season if you attempt to make them yourself and even then, its going to take several hours of crafting to finish each. ^xD02090You should just use that time to farm and then just save yourself the effort by buying them.^7
Once you have both, simply socket them in and swap your ^xFFFF77Passive Tree^7 as shown in the ^xFFFF77Step 11 Loadout^7. Make sure to not replace your ^xFFFF77Overwhelming Malice Cluster^7. A few ^xAF6025Unique^7 ^xAF6025Jewels^7 are also being moved around, namely your ^xAF6025Light of Meaning^7 moving spots. You can also keep your ^xAF6025Foulborn Inspired Learnings^7 if you wish, you will just have to drop a few ^xFFFF77Passive Points^7 from your ^xFFFF77Cluster Jewels^7 to pick up the ^xFFFF77Jewel Socket^7 by ^xFFFF77Pain Attunement^7.
^xE05030Endgame^7 - ^xFFFF77New Jewels & Body Armour Implicits^7
^xFFFF77Emperor's Wit Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/JBEKdy9Yhl ^xFFFF77Split Personality Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/nrl7bJEvu0
The final few upgrades for this section will be getting two new ^xAF6025Unique Jewels^7 along with swapping the ^xFFFF77Implicits^7 on your ^xFFFF77Body Armour^7.
If you wish to keep your ^xAF6025Foulborn Inspired Learnings^7 then do so but, if you wish to upgrade away from them, you will now look for an ^xAF6025Emperor's Wit^7 and an ^x7070FFIntelligence^7/^x7070FFMana^7 ^xAF6025Split Personality^7. The ^xAF6025Emperor's Wit^7 is just an increase to your ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 that ends up beating out all other ^xFFFF77Jewels^7 with how much ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 you now have due to the ^xFFFF77Cluster Jewels^7. As or your^xFFFF77 Body Armour^7, you will now want to swap out the ^x8888FFPhysical Damage taken as Chaos^7 ^xFFFF77Implicit^7 for the ^x8888FF1% Less Damage taken per x Intelligence^7 ^xFFFF77Implicit^7. Not only will this give you as much ^xFFFF77Physical Reduction^7 as the ^xFFFF77Conversion Mod^7 did, but it will also apply to all damage types making you tankier to elemental damage.
You should make this mod a ^xFFFF77Perfect Tier^7 with ^xFFFF77Orbs of Conflict^7 as it is very very important and each additional ^xFFFF77Tier^7 is a large boost.
^xD02090----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Step 12--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------^7
At this point, you can consider the build done. Everything you have done up until this point will be more than enough to handle most content with no issues. Your ^xFFFF77DPS^7 and clear should feel amazing while your ^xFFFF77EHP^7 should be enough to facetank everything. If you wish to move on to another build, this is the time to do so.
The next upgrade will be a ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 which will simply just cost ^x7070FF1-2 Mirrors^7 depending on popularity. This will never be any cheaper and that does just mean you will need to farm ^x7070FF1-2 Mirrors^7 at this point to be able to continue with the build. This will likely be something that is a hard pill to swallow for most people but, if you truly love the build and want to keep going, ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 is well worth its price tag as it is simply one of if not the single most powerful item in the game when used correctly.
^xE05030Endgame^7 - ^x70FF70Sublime Vision Swap^7
^xFFFF77Sublime Vision Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/2KnqPKbdIk ^xFFFF77Watcher's Eye Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/MdYrD6JqFJ
^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 is going to be a major rework of this build's defences. Up until now, all you had in the build was ^x70FF70Evasion^7, ^xFFFF7775% Resistances^7, some ^xFFFF77Physical to Chaos^7, good ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 recovery, ^xFFFF77CI^7, and a large ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7 pool. While all of this on paper sounds great, you cant really go past ~^xFFFF77150k Elemental Max Hit^7 (the actual scarry damage types). To aid with this, we ideally want to focus on ^xFFFF77Maximum Resistances^7 which we have completely ignored up until now. The issue with that is that getting a resistance to ^xFFFF7790%^7 to use^xAF6025 Melding of the Flesh^7 isn't really reasonable to do nor do you have the ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 space to really deal with the negatives of ^xAF6025Melding^7 without losing out on your ^xFFFF77Flasks^7.
This is where^xAF6025 Sublime Vision^7 is going to come in and fix all of this. In our case, we want a ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 which will cause ^xFFFF7730%^7 of all ^xADAA47Lightning^7 and ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 damage you take to instead be converted to ^xB97123Fire^7 damage. While this on its own doesn't really seem worth the ^x7070FF1-2 Mirror^7 price tag, it is the final (and rarest) price needed to be able to achieve ^xFFFF77100%^7 of ^xADAA47Lightning^7 and ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 damage to be taken as ^xB97123Fire^7 damage.
If you are able to achieve^xFFFF77 100% ^7conversion, then all we would have to do is focus on getting ^xFFFF7790%^7 ^xB97123Maximum Fire Resistance^7 which then effectively means^xFFFF77 90% Max^7 ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 and ^xADAA47Lightning^7 as well. With ^xFFFF77100%^7 conversion this also means you have no need for ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 or ^xADAA47Lightning^7 ^xFFFF77Resistance^7 anymore, opening up a lot of space on your gear for other ^xFFFF77Suffixes^7.
To achieve this, we are going to combine the ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 with the exact same ^xE05030Purity of Fire^7 mod on a ^xAF6025Watcher's Eye^7 giving you another ^xFFFF7720%^7 conversion. Lastly, this will be paired with a ^xAF6025Lethal Pride^7 under ^xFFFF77Rakiata^7 giving you access to the ^xFFFF77Tempered by War Keystone^7 for the final ^xFFFF7750%^7.
With all three of these items, you will now only ever take ^xFFFF77Physical^7 and ^xB97123Fire^7 damage given you have ^xFFFF77CI^7.
This will cause some issues, namely, ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 will not allow you to use any other ^x7070FFAura^7 execpt ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7. What this means for our build is that we will now have to swap over to using non ^x7070FFAura^7 skills that reserve Mana such as ^x7070FFAspect of the Spider^7.
This also gives us the chance to run ^x70FF70Arctic Armor^7 which offers ^xFFFF77Less Physical^7 and ^xB97123Less Fire^7 damage taken while standing still which... are the only two damage types you can take making this a very broken defensive skill to use now.
^x70FF70Requirements^7
First, make sure you buy the correct ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7 and not some other ^x7070FFAura^7.
You will also need the ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Watcher's Eye^7 mod as mentioned before. This ^xD02090HAS^7 to be ^xFFFF77Divine'd^7 to ^xFFFF7720%^7. Every ^xFFFF771%^7 under ^xFFFF7720%^7 will cause you to take ^xFFFF77~10% More Damage^7. You are free to look for any second or third ^xAF6025Watcher's Eye^7 mod that you want as before.
Lastly, you will need a ^xAF6025Lethal Pride^7 that is in the name of ^xFFFF77Rakiata^7. If possible, you want one that will give you ^x8888FFIntimidate on Hit^7 as one of its nodes. To find a ^xAF6025Lethal Pride^7, use ^xFFFF77PoB's^7 built in ^xAF6025Timeless Jewel^7 finder.
1. Go to the ^xFFFF77Passive Tree^7 and click on ^x70FF70Find Timeless Jewel^7 at the bottom.
2. ^xFFFF77Select^7:^x70FF70 Lethal Pride^7 - ^x70FF70Rakiata^7 - ^x70FF70Ghost Dance^7 - Check the "^x70FF70Filter Nodes^7" option
3. Click on "^x70FF70Search for Node^7" and select ^x8888FFIntimidate^7. In the list in the^xFFFF77 Bottom Right^7 you should see "^x70FF70karui_notable_add_intimidate, 1, 0, 1^7"
4. Click on ^x70FF70Fallback Weight Mode^7 and set it to ^x70FF70Full DPS^7 and then click ^x70FF70Generate^7. In the ^xFFFF77Fallback Tab^7 there should be some lines added.
5.^x70FF70 Click on Search at the bottom^7. A bunch of numbers should now be generated on the right side. Click "^x70FF70Copy Trade URL^7" and paste it into your browser. ^xD02090Number 17127 will be the only option with Intimidate on it.^7
The ^xFFFF77Trade URL^7 you copied will show you the "best" ^xAF6025Lethal Prides^7 sorted by ^xFFFF77DPS^7. If you do not see any up for sale that means none of those numbers are up for sale currently.
Simply go back to ^xFFFF77PoB^7 and click ^x70FF70Copy Trade URL^7 again and it will generate a new one with the next best options. Do this a few times and generate ^xFFFF773-4 ^7different searches as basically everything except for ^xD0209017127^7 will be as good as each other. Once you have done so, just buy the cheapest one.
^x70FF70New Helmet^7
^xFFFF77Black Morrigan Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/eRGyEMG6cL ^xFFFF77Fenumus Trade Link^7 - https://www.pathofexile.com/trade/search/Keepers/X3mMgp7bhP
On top of this you will also likely need a new ^xFFFF77Helmet^7. The goal is to get your ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7 to ^xFFFF7723^7 in order to reach the breakpoint needed for ^xFFFF7790%^7 ^xB97123Maximum Fire Resistance^7. This will be done by using a ^x7070FF+2 Aura^7 ^x8888FFEssence of Delirium^7 until you also hit ^xFFFF77Tier 1^7 ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 with an ^xFFFF77Open Suffix^7.
Once you have done so, buy a ^xAF6025Black Morrigan^7 along with a ^xAF6025Fenumus, First of the Night^7 and craft ^xFFFF77Level 30^7 ^x7070FFAspect of the Spider^7 onto the ^xFFFF77Open Suffix^7 through the ^xFFFF77Menagere^7.
As for the ^xFFFF77Prefixes^7, you will have to brick your ^xFFFF77Eldritch Implicits^7 so you can make the ^xB97123Searing Exarch^7 be dominant and then you should use ^xFFFF77Eldritch Orbs of Chaos^7 until you get ^xFFFF77Tier 3^7 or higher ^x7070FFMana^7 or ^x8888FFEnergy Shield^7. From there you can use an ^xFFFF77Eldritch Orb of Annulment ^7to remove any third ^xFFFF77Prefix^7 the ^xFFFF77Eldritch Orb of Chaos^7 might have added to then craft ^x7070FFMana^7 or ^x7070FFEnergy Shield^7. It is up to you if you wish to try and ^xFFFF77Eldritch Orbs of Chaos^7 a higher mod, trying to get ^xFFFF77Tier 1^7 ^x7070FFMana^7 or ^x7070FFIntelligence^7 with an ^xFFFF77Open Prefix^7 will be quite expensive.
After you have finished recrafting it, redo your ^xFFFF77Eldritch Implicits^7 back to ^x7070FFDespair Effect^7 and ^x8888FFPhysical to Chaos^7.
^x70FF70New Flasks^7
You will also need to make one change to your ^xFFFF77Flasks^7. You will want to swap from a ^x70FF70Bismuth^7 ^xFFFF77Flask^7 over to a ^xB97123Ruby^7 ^xFFFF77Flask^7. You will not need ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 and ^xADAA47Lightning^7 ^xFFFF77Resistance^7 anymore and the ^xB97123Maximum Fire Resistance ^7from the ^xB97123Ruby^7 ^xFFFF77Flask^7 is required to get to ^xFFFF7790%^7.
Make sure to use^xFFFF77 Enkindling Orbs^7 on it to get ^x8888FF70% increased Effect^7 and the ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 you get is simply based on whatever was on your ^x70FF70Bismuth^7 ^xFFFF77Flask^7. If you had the ^x8888FFElemental Resistance^7 ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 on it, replace it with the^x8888FF Movement Speed^7 ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 and if the ^x8888FFElemental Resistance^7 ^xFFFF77Suffix^7 was on a different ^xFFFF77Flask^7, replace that ^xFFFF77Flask's Suffix^7 with ^x8888FFMovement Speed^7.
^x70FF70Putting It All Together^7
With a new ^xFFFF77Helmet^7 with ^xFFFF77Level 30^7 ^x7070FFAspect of the Spider^7 and a ^xFFFF77Level 21/20^7 ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7, ^xB97123Ruby^7 ^xFFFF77Flask^7, ^xAF6025Lethal Pride^7, ^xFFFF7720%^7 ^x3F6DB3Cold^7 and ^xADAA47Lightning^7 taken as ^xB97123Fire^7 ^xAF6025Watcher's Eye^7 and a ^xB97123Purity of Fire^7 ^xAF6025Sublime Vision^7, its time to swap over. Simply make all of the gem changes in the Skills tab as shown and make all of the ^xFFFF77Passive Tree^7 changes as well.
At this point in the build I have opted to swap to a ^xAF6025Bottled Faith^7 with ^xFFFF77Zealot's Oath^7 for better tankiness against ^xAF6025Bosses^7 but you can stick to the ^xAF6025Atziri^7 setup too. I also choose to replace one ^xFFFF77Flask Suffix^7 with the crafted ^x8888FFRegen 3% of Life per Second^7 mod to go along with ^xFFFF77Zealot's Oath^7. I personally found this to be comfier for ^x7070FFValdo Maps^7.
Once you have made all of these changes, you will basically double your total ^xFFFF77Elemental EHP^7 and pretty much nothing in the game should be able to kill you ever again. You can now do the hardest of content in the game with ease and if you wish to try out ^x7070FFValdo Maps^7, you now have everything you need to not instantly die.
Please keep in mind there are still some ^x7070FFValdo Map^7 combos that will turn even this setup into wet paper but, those are the very dumb ones almost no one would realistically run anyways. Most ^x70FF702-4 Ghost^7 ^xAF6025Feared^7 ^x7070FFValdo Maps^7 should be quite easy with the only scary things being ^xFFFF774^7 very very bad synergistic ^x70FF70Ghost Mods^7 on ^xAF6025Shaper^7 or ^xAF6025Elder^7 or ^xFFFF772-4^7 random mods + ^x70FF70Frenzy Charges^7.
^xD02090----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------Step 13--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------^7^7
The final thing you can do at this point is to start ^x7070FFMirroring^7 items, craft them yourself or craft near ^x7070FFMirror-Tier^7 items as shown in the ^xFFFF77Endgame Gear Crafting Loadout^7.
All of the items shown in this setup are very difficult and expensive to craft. Some (such as the ^xFFFF77Body Armour^7) will cost over ^x7070FF1 Mirror^7 on average to make. Making crafting guides for these is quite pointless as you likely know how to make them if you have gotten this far into the build.
If you have any questions on crafting any of the items shown here, please do feel free to reach out and I can provide any help I can.
